```{r Initialize working environment}

# Function to silently load packages without warnings or messages
load_packages <- function(pkgs) {
  invisible(
    lapply(pkgs, function(pkg) {
      suppressWarnings(
        suppressMessages(
          if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
            stop(paste("❌ Package not found:", pkg), call. = FALSE)
          }
        )
      )
    })
  )
}

# Vector of required packages
packages_needed <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "ggtree", "ggtreeExtra", "ggplot2", 
                     "treeio", "scatterpie", "ape", "openxlsx", "tibble",
                     "patchwork", "ape", "ggforce")

# Call the function to load them
load_packages(packages_needed)

# Print the information of the working session in order to ensure reproducibility
sessionInfo()
```

# Generate individual phylogenetic trees (*actG*, *CalM*, ITS region, *tefA*, *tubB*)

```{r Extraction of UFbootstrap Values from Individual Gene trees (5 genes)}

# Function to extract UFbootstrap values from an IQ-TREE tree file and export
# them as an Excel table compatible with ggtree node-based joins
extract_iqtree_ufboot_to_xlsx <- function(treefile, out_xlsx) {

  # Read the phylogenetic tree generated by IQ-TREE
  tr <- read.tree(treefile)

  # Retrieve the number of terminal taxa and internal nodes
  n_tip  <- length(tr$tip.label)
  n_node <- tr$Nnode

  # Create a node-level table using the same internal node numbering as ggtree
  boot <- tibble(node   = (n_tip + 1):(n_tip + n_node),
                 ufboot = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tr$node.label)))

  # Export the UFbootstrap table as an Excel file
  write.xlsx(boot, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)

  # Report successful file creation
  message("\nExcel created successfully: ", out_xlsx)
}


# Define the set of genes to be processed
genes <- c("actG", "CalM", "ITS", "tefA", "tubB")


# Iterate over each gene and extract its corresponding UFbootstrap values
for (i in seq_along(genes)) {
  gene <- genes[i]
  
  # Select the gene-specific output directory
  out_dir_phy <- paste0("../data/outputs_script_2/", i, "_", gene, "/")

  # Extract UFbootstrap values and save them as a gene-specific Excel file
  extract_iqtree_ufboot_to_xlsx(
    treefile = paste0("../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/MSA_", 
                      gene, "_UFBoot1000.treefile"),
    out_xlsx = paste0(out_dir_phy, "UFBoot_values_", gene, ".xlsx")
  )
}

```

```{r Visualization and export of individual gene phylogenetic trees (5 genes)}

# Function to generate and export annotated and unannotated phylogenetic trees
process_tree <- function(gene_name, index) {

  # Define input and output file paths for the selected gene
  treefile_path <- paste0("../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/MSA_", 
                          gene_name, "_UFBoot1000.treefile")

  output_dir <- paste0("../data/outputs_script_2/", index, "_", gene_name, "/")

  # Define the path to the gene-specific UFbootstrap table
  ufbootfile_path <- paste0(output_dir, "UFBoot_values_", gene_name, ".xlsx")

  # Check that all required input files are available
  if (!file.exists(treefile_path)) stop("Tree file not found: ", treefile_path)
  if (!file.exists(ufbootfile_path)) stop("UFboot xlsx not found: ", ufbootfile_path)

  # Read the phylogenetic tree and transform branch lengths for visualization
  tree <- read.tree(treefile_path)
  tree$edge.length <- sqrt(sqrt(tree$edge.length))

  # Create the base ggtree object
  base_tree <- ggtree(tree, size = 0.4)

  # Extract plotting coordinates for internal node
  tree_coords <- base_tree$data %>% dplyr::filter(isTip == FALSE)

  # Load UFbootstrap values associated with internal nodes
  ufboot <- read.xlsx(ufbootfile_path)

  # Verify that the UFbootstrap table contains the required columns
  if (!all(c("node", "ufboot") %in% names(ufboot))) {
    stop("UFboot file must contain columns 'node' and 'ufboot': ", ufbootfile_path)
  }

  # Join node coordinates with their corresponding UFbootstrap values
  tree_data <- left_join(tree_coords, ufboot, by = "node")

  # Generate the phylogenetic tree annotated with UFbootstrap values
  tree_with_boot <- base_tree +
    geom_label2(data = tree_data, aes(x = x, y = y, group = node, label = ufboot),
                color = "black", size = 3) +
    geom_tiplab(size = 4, align = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = "#f7f7f7") +
    xlim(0, max(base_tree$data$x) + 1)

  # Export the annotated tree as a PDF file
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(output_dir, gene_name, "_individual_ufboot.pdf"),
    plot = tree_with_boot,
    width = 8.27, height = 11.69, units = "in"
  )

  # Generate the same phylogenetic tree without displaying UFbootstrap values
  tree_empty <- base_tree +
    geom_label2(data = tree_data, aes(x = x, y = y, group = node, label = NA)) +
    geom_tiplab(size = 4, align = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = "#f7f7f7") +
    xlim(0, max(base_tree$data$x) + 2)

  # Export the unannotated tree as a PDF file
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(output_dir, gene_name, "_individual_empty.pdf"),
    plot = tree_empty,
    width = 8.27, height = 11.69, units = "in"
  )
}


# Apply the plotting function to all individual gene trees
invisible(mapply(process_tree, genes, seq_along(genes)))

```

# Generate MSC trees (ASTRAL)

```{r Extraction of quartet and posterior probability values from the MSC Tree}

# Helper function to parse quartet support values from ASTRAL node labels
parse_astral_quartets <- function(lbl) {

  if (is.null(lbl) || is.na(lbl)) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_))
  lbl <- as.character(lbl)

  # Check whether quartet values are stored as explicit q1, q2, and q3 fields
  has_keys <- grepl("q1\\s*=", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE) &&
              grepl("q2\\s*=", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE) &&
              grepl("q3\\s*=", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)

  if (has_keys) {
    q1 <- sub(".*q1\\s*=\\s*([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)
    q2 <- sub(".*q2\\s*=\\s*([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)
    q3 <- sub(".*q3\\s*=\\s*([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)
    return(as.numeric(c(q1, q2, q3)))
  }

  # Otherwise, attempt to parse three delimiter-separated numeric values
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(lbl, "[/\\|,;:]+"))
  parts <- parts[nchar(parts) > 0]

  if (length(parts) >= 3) {
    return(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[1:3])))
  }

  # Return missing values if the quartet information cannot be parsed
  c(NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_)
}


# Extract quartet support values from an ASTRAL species tree and export them to Excel
extract_astral_Q_to_xlsx <- function(treefile, out_xlsx) {

  # Read the ASTRAL species tree
  tr <- read.tree(treefile)

  # Define internal node identifiers using the same numbering scheme as ggtree
  n_tip  <- length(tr$tip.label)
  n_node <- tr$Nnode
  internal_nodes <- (n_tip + 1):(n_tip + n_node)

  # Retrieve node labels containing ASTRAL support information
  labels <- tr$node.label

  # Parse q1, q2, and q3 values for each internal node
  Qmat <- t(vapply(labels, parse_astral_quartets, numeric(3)))
  colnames(Qmat) <- c("q1", "q2", "q3")

  # Build a node-level table of quartet support values
  Q_df <- tibble(
    node = internal_nodes,
    q1 = Qmat[, "q1"],
    q2 = Qmat[, "q2"],
    q3 = Qmat[, "q3"]
  )

  # Export the quartet support table as an Excel file
  write.xlsx(Q_df, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
  message("\n\nASTRAL Q Excel created successfully: ", out_xlsx, "\n\n")

  # Warn the user if no quartet values could be parsed
  if (all(is.na(Q_df$q1)) && all(is.na(Q_df$q2)) && all(is.na(Q_df$q3))) {
    message("Warning: q1/q2/q3 are all NA. The quartet values may not be 
            stored in node labels in this treefile.")
  }
}


# Extract quartet support values from the ASTRAL species tree
extract_astral_Q_to_xlsx(
  treefile = "../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ASTRAL_SPTREE_Q",
  out_xlsx = "../data/outputs_script_2/6_MSCtree/Q_values_ASTRAL_SPTREE.xlsx"
)


# Helper function to parse posterior probability values from ASTRAL node labels
parse_astral_pp <- function(lbl) {

  if (is.null(lbl) || is.na(lbl)) return(NA_real_)
  lbl <- as.character(lbl)

  # Parse labels stored as pp=... or PP=...
  if (grepl("pp\\s*=", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    val <- sub(".*pp\\s*=\\s*([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)
    return(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(val)))
  }

  # Otherwise, attempt direct numeric conversion of the node label
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lbl))
}


# Extract posterior probability values from an ASTRAL species tree and export them to Excel
extract_astral_PP_to_xlsx <- function(treefile, out_xlsx) {

  # Read the ASTRAL species tree
  tr <- read.tree(treefile)

  # Define internal node identifiers using the same numbering scheme as ggtree
  n_tip  <- length(tr$tip.label)
  n_node <- tr$Nnode
  internal_nodes <- (n_tip + 1):(n_tip + n_node)

  # Retrieve node labels containing posterior probability information
  labels <- tr$node.label

  # Build a node-level table of posterior probability values
  PP_df <- tibble(
    node = internal_nodes,
    pp   = vapply(labels, parse_astral_pp, numeric(1))
  )

  # Export the posterior probability table as an Excel file
  write.xlsx(PP_df, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
  message("\n\nASTRAL PP Excel created successfully: ", out_xlsx, "\n\n")
  
  # Warn the user if no posterior probability values could be parsed
  if (all(is.na(PP_df$pp))) {
    message("Warning: pp is all NA. The PP values may not be stored in node labels in this treefile.")
  }
}


# Extract posterior probability values from the ASTRAL species tree
extract_astral_PP_to_xlsx(
  treefile = "../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ASTRAL_SPTREE_PP",
  out_xlsx = "../data/outputs_script_2/6_MSCtree/PP_values_ASTRAL_SPTREE.xlsx")

```

```{r Visualization and export of MSC tree with quartets and PP values}

# Define ASTRAL tree types and their corresponding support-value files
tree_configs <- list(
  Q  = list(tree_file = "../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ASTRAL_SPTREE_Q",
            data_file = "../data/outputs_script_2/6_MSCtree/Q_values_ASTRAL_SPTREE.xlsx"),
  PP = list(tree_file = "../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ASTRAL_SPTREE_PP",
            data_file = "../data/outputs_script_2/6_MSCtree/PP_values_ASTRAL_SPTREE.xlsx")
)

# Function to generate and export each ASTRAL species tree
process_astral_tree <- function(suffix, config) {

  # Define input and output paths
  tree_path  <- config$tree_file
  value_path <- config$data_file
  base_name  <- paste0("ASTRALSP_tree_", suffix)
  output_pdf <- paste0("../data/outputs_script_2/6_MSCtree/", base_name, ".pdf")

  # Check that all required input files are available
  if (!file.exists(tree_path)) stop("Tree file not found: ", tree_path)
  if (!file.exists(value_path)) stop("Support-value file not found: ", value_path)

  # Read the species tree and create the base ggtree object
  tree <- read.tree(tree_path)
  base_tree <- ggtree(tree, size = 0.4, layout = "rectangular")
  tree_coords <- base_tree$data %>% filter(isTip == FALSE)

  # Load node-level support values
  support_data <- read.xlsx(value_path)

  # Verify that the support table contains the required node column
  if (!"node" %in% colnames(support_data)) {
    stop("The support-value file does not contain a 'node' column: ", value_path)
  }

  # Join internal node coordinates with their corresponding support values
  merged_data <- left_join(tree_coords, support_data, by = "node")

  # Check that node matching produced a valid joined table
  if (nrow(merged_data) == 0) {
    stop("No matching nodes between tree and support data for suffix: _", suffix)
  }

  # Initialize the species tree plot with tip labels
  plot <- base_tree + geom_tiplab(size = 4, align = TRUE)

  if (suffix == "Q") {
    # Convert quartet support columns to numeric values
    merged_data$q1 <- as.numeric(merged_data$q1)
    merged_data$q2 <- as.numeric(merged_data$q2)
    merged_data$q3 <- as.numeric(merged_data$q3)

    # Add pie charts representing quartet support proportions at internal nodes
    plot <- plot +
      geom_scatterpie(data = merged_data, aes(x = x, y = y, group = node, r = 0.35),
                      cols = c("q1", "q2", "q3"), color = "black", size = 0.3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("q1" = "#855885", "q2" = "#f1a340", "q3" = "#f7f7f7")) +
      xlim(0, max(base_tree$data$x, na.rm = TRUE) + 6) +
      ylim(0, max(base_tree$data$y, na.rm = TRUE) + 2)

  } else if (suffix == "PP") {
    # Convert posterior probability values to numeric format
    merged_data$pp <- as.numeric(merged_data$pp)

    # Add posterior probability labels to internal nodes
    plot <- plot +
      geom_label2(data = merged_data, aes(x = x, y = y, group = node, label = pp),
                  color = "black", size = 3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = "#f7f7f7") +
      xlim(NA, 22) +
      ylim(NA, 38)
  }

  # Export the final species tree plot as a PDF file
  ggsave(output_pdf, plot = plot, width = 8.10, height = 12.5, units = "in")
}

# Generate and export all configured ASTRAL species tree plots
invisible(mapply(process_astral_tree, names(tree_configs), tree_configs))

```

# Generate ML concatenated phylogenetic tree

```{r Extraction of sCFL and UFbootstrap values from the ML concatenated Tree}

# Extract node identifiers, sCF-like values, and UFbootstrap labels from an
# IQ-TREE cf.stat file and export them as an Excel table
extract_scfl_and_ufboot_from_cfstat <- function(cf_stat_file, out_xlsx) {

  # Read the cf.stat file while ignoring comment lines
  stat <- read.delim(
    cf_stat_file,
    sep = "\t",
    header = TRUE,
    comment.char = "#",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  # Verify that the required columns are present
  required_cols <- c("ID", "sCF", "Label")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(stat))) {
    stop("cf.stat must contain columns: ID, sCF, Label")
  }

  # Select and rename support-value columns for downstream plotting
  out <- stat %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      node   = as.numeric(ID),
      scfl   = as.numeric(sCF),
      ufboot = as.numeric(Label)
    )

  # Export the support-value table as an Excel file
  write.xlsx(out, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  # Report successful file creation
  message("\n\nExcel with node, scfl and ufboot created: ", out_xlsx, "\n\n")
}


# Extract ML-tree support values and export them as an Excel file
extract_scfl_and_ufboot_from_cfstat(
  cf_stat_file = "../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ML_TREE.cf.stat",
  out_xlsx = "../data/outputs_script_2/7_MLtree/UFBoot_and_scfl_values_MLtree.xlsx"
)

```

```{r Visualization and export of MSL concatenated tree with UFboot and SCFL values}
# Read the ML tree and transform branch lengths for visualization
treeML <- read.tree("../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ML_TREE.treefile")
treeML$edge.length <- sqrt(sqrt(treeML$edge.length))

# Extract plotting coordinates for internal nodes
treeML_coordinates <- base_treeML$data
treeML_coordinates <- treeML_coordinates %>% filter(isTip == FALSE)

# Load node-level UFbootstrap and sCF support values
bootscfl <- read.xlsx("../data/outputs_script_2/7_MLtree/UFBoot_and_scfl_values_MLtree.xlsx")

# Join internal node coordinates with their corresponding support values

  xlim(0, max(base_treeML$data$x) + 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(1, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.1, 0))

# Export the sCF-annotated ML tree as a PDF file
ggsave("../data/outputs_script_2/7_MLtree/MLtree_scfl.pdf",

# Generate the ML tree without internal node support labels

  geom_label2(data = ML_data, aes(x = x, y = y, group = node, label = NA), 
              color = "black", size = 3) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 4, align = TRUE) +
  xlim(0, max(base_treeML$data$x) + 3) +

# Export the unannotated ML tree as a PDF file
```
